display_title: Love is a Sport: Outfield Base Running
mangabaka_title: Love is a Sport: Outfield Base Running
description:
Selected for the Olympic baseball team, Sae-Ram enters the athletes village only to reunite with his former youth teammate, Ji-Ho. Despite years of silence, they are assigned as roommates based on their history. Ji-Ho has always harbored a hidden interest in Sae-Ram and quickly seizes the opportunity. Under the guise of sports massages, his touch grows increasingly bold and intimate. Seeing a heated side of the man who once only teased him, Sae-Ram feels his heart begin to race. Is this just intense team bonding or the start of a dangerous game?

(Source: Tappytoon)

*Note: Part of Kingdom Company's Sarangi Kkotpineun Seonsuchon (사랑이 꽃피는 선수촌) Collection.*
